about_the_game:
Genre and theme: Vertical scroll shooter sci-fi space combat game

Game mechanics: Shoot, dodge, collect power-ups, fight bosses, complete missions. Progress through 25 levels, combat 75 different enemy types. Pilot your spaceship, shoot down enemies, avoid incoming fire, and collect upgrades. Each level features unique objectives and difficulty.

Core appeal: Intense action, strategic analysis, and progressive difficulty. The game builds challenge across 25 levels while introducing new enemy types and mechanics. Pixel-perfect collision detection and varied enemy AI ensure deep gameplay experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD A8-7600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 520 / AMD Radeon R5)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any basic audio output
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card (GTX 1050 / RX 560 or better)
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated audio card or high-quality onboard audio

short_description: A vertical scroll shooter sci-fi space combat game where you pilot your spaceship through 25 challenging levels, engaging in intense battles against 75 unique enemy types. Master precise shooting mechanics, dodge incoming fire, collect power-ups to enhance your ship, and face epic boss battles.
